english_description: The RFC 8439 authenticated-encryption composition of scalar ChaCha20 and Poly1305.

queries.english: Return the encrypted length for a plaintext of this size.
queries.rust_sig: fn encryption_output_length(&self, plaintext_length: usize) -> Result<usize, CryptoError>

queries.english: Return the decrypted length for a ciphertext including its tag.
queries.rust_sig: fn decryption_output_length(&self, ciphertext_length: usize) -> Result<usize, CryptoError>

queries.english: Report whether this ciphertext and tag authenticate for these inputs.
queries.rust_sig: fn verify(&self, key: &[u8; 32], nonce: &[u8; 12], aad: &[u8], ciphertext_and_tag: &[u8]) -> bool

commands.english: Encrypt plaintext and return the ciphertext followed by its authentication tag.
commands.rust_sig: fn encrypt(&mut self, key: &[u8; 32], nonce: &[u8; 12], aad: &[u8], plaintext: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CryptoError>

commands.english: Authenticate ciphertext and return plaintext only when its tag is valid.
commands.rust_sig: fn decrypt(&mut self, key: &[u8; 32], nonce: &[u8; 12], aad: &[u8], ciphertext_and_tag: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CryptoError>

constraints.english: The plaintext length stays within the RFC 8439 message limit.
Ciphertext includes a full tag and its message stays within the RFC 8439 limit.
Decryption succeeds exactly when the supplied ciphertext and tag authenticate.
Successful encryption returns the plaintext and one sixteen-byte tag.
Successful decryption returns the ciphertext message without its sixteen-byte tag.

adversary_table.scenario: Encrypt empty data and data lengths around the sixteen-byte block boundary.
adversary_table.resolution: append exactly one tag and match the pinned vector

adversary_table.scenario: Decrypt ciphertext whose authentication tag has one changed bit.
adversary_table.resolution: return an authentication error and no plaintext

adversary_table.scenario: Request a message length above the RFC 8439 maximum.
adversary_table.resolution: return a length error before counter wrap

adversary_table.scenario: Run with an optimized Botan provider enabled.
adversary_table.resolution: record provider parity as deferred and make no first-pass SIMD claim

source_references.notes: Encryption/decryption order, output lengths, and message limit.
Pinned Botan includes the RFC ChaCha20-Poly1305 test vector.

depends_on.reason: The AEAD composition uses ChaCha20 to encrypt message bytes and derive the Poly1305 one-time key.
The AEAD composition uses Poly1305 to authenticate associated data and ciphertext.
